youtube.baslik: Is it a bad sign if dizziness increases during exercise? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In vestibular rehabilitation, a practical way to monitor symptoms during exercise is a symptom score from zero to ten; in the example, the score is two before exercise, rises to five during it, and soon falls back to baseline after it ends, which shows a suitable intensity. If the score rises very high and stays up for a long time, the intensity is reduced; a new symptom, a fall or a decline in general condition is reported to the clinician right away.
